jobs.title: Customer Operations Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT HUD

HUD https://www.hud.ai/'s mission is to build reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI data. We want data to be valuable for the people who create it and trustworthy for the labs that train on it. Our team is a quickly growing group of researchers, engineers and operators building the economy that shapes what AI will become. Backed by $16M from top VCs and YC (W25), our marketplace and platform are used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Customer Operations Lead to own the customer-facing work that cannot or should not be automated with AI. You’ll own the systems around successful customer activation and engagement as the implementation counterpart to our GTM Engineers https://app.notion.com/p/GTM-Engineer-34c0ab86437b8085910ced1c0c4fc1a2?pvs=21.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the human-in-the-loop layer of HUD’s operations across our customers - data suppliers (vendors) and frontier labs and enterprises (buyers)

 - Jump into customer conversations when a human touch is needed to build trust, clarify context, or move things forward

 - Resolve contract, onboarding, and platform blockers by working with the right internal owners

 - Turn recurring customer issues, feedback, and learnings into better processes, platform, and communications

 - Build lightweight systems that streamline workflows or makes resolving problems easier the next time they occur


EXPERIENCE

You may be a good fit if you have:

 - Experience in customer operations, business operations, consulting, or similar roles

 - Familiar with CRM tools, external vendor management and AI-native CRM campaigns, email tracking

 - Demonstrated judgement in customer-facing situations - you know when to be helpful, when to push back, and when to escalate

 - Comfort managing many small but important threads at once

 - High attention to detail and strong follow-through

 - Used AI tools to improve their productivity

Strong candidates may also have:

 - Early-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast-paced environments

 - Experience working with technical customers

 - Familiarity with RL, e.g., you know what environments, evals, and benchmarks are

 - Thrive in unstructured problem spaces

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.


TEAM & COMPANY DETAILS

 - Team Size: ~25 people currently, mostly full-time in-person, but some remote.

 - Our team: Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.

 - Company stage: We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand.


LOGISTICS

 - Employment: Full-time.

 - Location: We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who can work hours that 70-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones.

 - Visa Sponsorship: We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full-time candidates to the US or Singapore.

 - Timeline: Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2-3 day work trial.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation

 - 100% covered top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision (US and Singapore employees)

 - Lunch and dinner for in-office employees

 - Company-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays

 - Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees) and a health/wellness stipend (Singapore employees)

 - Unlimited* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. *By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.

 - Two top-floor offices in San Francisco’s Union Square and Singapore’s Raffles Place

 - Annual travel budget to visit either office


COMPENSATION

Actual offers are adjusted for experience and location, but our base salary bands are

 - San Francisco (and other major US cities): $100,000 - $165,000

 - Singapore: $100,000 - $120,000

 - Rest of world: $100,000 - $120,000

Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at recruiting@hud.so or elsewhere if we missed your application!

ABOUT HUD

HUD https://www.hud.ai/'s mission is to build reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI data. We want data to be valuable for the people who create it and trustworthy for the labs that train on it. Our team is a quickly growing group of researchers, engineers and operators building the economy that shapes what AI will become. Backed by $16M from top VCs and YC (W25), our marketplace and platform are used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Legal Operations Lead to build and own the systems, processes, and commercial frameworks enable HUD to move more quickly as our volume and complexity of agreements grows.

This is not a traditional in-house counsel role. We’re looking for someone who combines strong legal and contracting judgment with an operator’s instinct for systems, tooling, and leverage. You should be comfortable handling a contract directly one day and redesigning the process so it barely needs manual intervention the next.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own day-to-day legal operations - drafting and negotiating SOWs, chasing signatures, and monitoring timelines for invoicing will be 25-50% of your time

 - Draft, review, and negotiate routine commercial agreements across buyers, data vendors, and other partners, including MSAs, SOWs, data licenses, SLAs, NDAs, vendor agreements, and other bespoke arrangements

 - Build and continuously improve templates and negotiation playbooks so recurring issues such as data rights and usage restrictions can be handled quickly and consistently

 - Identify opportunities to automate or streamline high-volume legal workflows using software and AI, while preserving appropriate human review for judgment-heavy issues

 - Establish clear rules for what should be handled internally, what can be standardized or automated, and what should be escalated to founders or outside counsel

 - Manage outside counsel strategically, including scoping work, preparing issues efficiently, controlling legal spend, and ensuring external lawyers are used primarily for high-value or specialist questions


EXPERIENCE

You may be a good fit if you have:

 - Experience in legal operations, contracts management, commercial operations, transactional legal work, business operations, or a combination of these at a fast-growing technology company

 - Strong experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial technology agreements, with the judgment to distinguish routine issues from matters that require specialist legal advice

 - Comfort working with legal technology, workflow tools, and AI, and an interest in using them to make legal work materially faster and more scalable

 - Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance legal risk against speed, customer needs, and business priorities

 - Excellent written communication, attention to detail, and the confidence to push back constructively on sophisticated customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders

Strong candidates may also have:

 - Legal training, including experience at a law firm or in-house legal team, but prefer operating and building systems over practicing law as a traditional counsel

 - Experience building or scaling legal operations, contract management, or a deal desk from an early stage

 - Experience with data licensing, IP-intensive transactions, marketplaces, or other businesses where contractual rights are closely tied to the product

 - Experience managing outside counsel

 - Early-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast-paced environments

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.

 - Team Size: ~25 people currently, mostly full-time in-person, but some remote.

 - Company stage: We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand.

 - Employment: Full-time.

 - Location: San Francisco or Singapore offices only for this role.

 - Timeline: Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2-3 day work trial.

 - 100% covered top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision (US and Singapore employees)

 - Company-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Business Operations generalist to help build and run HUD’s operating systems. You’ll work closely with our Chief of Staff and founders across hiring, finance, marketing and events, and cross-functional special projects.

This role is an exceptional learning opportunity for an early-career generalist who already has some early-stage startup experience. The work is both extremely fast-paced and extremely wide-ranging, giving this person unique access to every part of the company. The Chief of Staff is also personally committing to mentoring this person for success at HUD and beyond.


RESPONSIBILITIES

This role is intentionally broad and will change depending on the company’s needs, but the focus of your first 3-6 months may include (but are not limited to):

 - Co-own hiring and people operations with the Chief of Staff, including recruiter management, feedback tracking, work trial management, and onboarding

 - Own day-to-day finance operations including transitioning payroll providers, expense tracking, invoice management, and vendor payments

 - Own or support cross-functional projects with the Chief of Staff and founders, turning open-ended business questions into clear recommendations and scalable systems

 - Draft public-facing content such as case studies, blog posts, social media posts, partnership announcement, etc.

 - Plan and run events including community gatherings to team offsites

 - Miscellaneous operations - everything from notarizing documents for our Singapore entity to onboarding a fractional general counsel

 - Active but thoughtful use of AI to enable and automate all of the above

 - 3–4 years of experience, including 2 years in management consulting (MBB or top-tier boutique) and 1–2 years at an early-stage startup in business operations or strategy and operations

 - Demonstrated experience taking ambiguous projects from initial problem structuring through implementation, with an eye on building scalable systems instead of point solutions

 - Strong organization and attention to detail, with the judgment to prioritize competing demands and keep commitments on track

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills—please link a writing sample

 - High agency balanced with good judgement on when to ask for more input or help to get things done on time

 - Comfort moving between strategic questions and everyday operational work, and learning unfamiliar parts of the business quickly
